programs.title: Reading the Sky, Governing the Tools: AI Governance for Working People
programs.grade_or_level: Adult continuing education / workplace short course
outcomes: Explain how an agent-managed, human-governed DAO keeps decisions like final votes and treasury transfers in human hands
Interpret a charter's measurable outcomes and track progress against them
Draft and debate a workplace proposal using evidence summaries

sessions.activity: Tour the DAO's charter: mission, contribution model and reserved human-only actions; map which workplace decisions learners would keep human-governed.
Use an Evidence Monitor summary on automation and jobs; practice separating claims from sources and writing a one-page evidence brief.
Small groups draft a mock union proposal with the Proposal & Grant Drafter agent; debate it and hold a human-only final vote.
Review the Progress Tracker dashboard; agree on three measurable outcomes for the group's own campaign and how to report them.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised pre/post confidence scores on AI governance concepts and anonymised proposal topic categories (no names, no workplace identifiers).
programs.consent: Voluntary participation with written informed consent; learners may opt out of data sharing entirely while still attending all sessions; no personal or employer-identifying data collected.

programs.title: Stonehenge Sky-Watchers to DAO Stewards
outcomes: Connect Stonehenge's solstice alignments to how humans have always organised shared knowledge
Describe what an agent-managed DAO is and which decisions stay with people
Simulate drafting and voting on a class proposal

sessions.activity: Explore the charter on Salisbury grassland: how does a community agree on rules? Compare megalith builders' shared plan to a DAO charter.
Meet the Evidence Monitor agent; sort real evidence cards into 'fact', 'opinion' and 'unknown' and build a mini synthesis poster.
Class drafts a proposal for a school improvement with agent help, debates amendments, and every student casts the human final vote.
Check the Progress Tracker: did the class proposal meet its measurable outcome? Chart results on a wall graph like a solstice alignment.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised class-level tally of votes and aggregated quiz scores; no individual learner data, names or ages shared.
programs.consent: Guardian/parent written consent required for participation and any data contribution; assent also sought from each child; guardians may withdraw consent at any time and all individual records are deleted.

programs.title: Evidence-to-Advocacy: Running Human-Governed Campaigns with Agent Support
programs.grade_or_level: Professional development for NGO programme and policy staff
outcomes: Structure a campaign around a charter with measurable outcomes
Use agent-drafted proposals and evidence syntheses without ceding decision authority
Design consentful, privacy-preserving data sharing with communities

sessions.activity: Workshop with Evidence Monitor and Research Synthesis Agent outputs: turn a synthesis into a briefing note with cited sources and flagged uncertainties.
See how Task Router coordinates working groups between decision cycles; participants design a working-group plan for their own campaign.
Participants refine an agent-drafted grant proposal, run a peer review panel, and practise the human-only enactment decision.
Define measurable outcomes and a progress-tracking rubric for one real NGO programme using the Progress Tracker format.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised, aggregated programme outcome indicators and de-identified proposal themes contributed to shared open briefing models; no beneficiary or community personal data.
programs.consent: Staff consent under a data minimisation policy; community data only shared with explicit, informed, revocable consent from those communities; all contributions stripped of identifiers before leaving the organisation.

programs.title: Charter-First Nonprofits: Mission, Evidence and Human Votes
outcomes: Write a mission-aligned charter with measurable outcomes and human-reserved decisions
Oversee agent drafting while keeping enactment, treasury and appointments human-only
Apply progress tracking to board reporting

sessions.activity: Study the DAO charter model: mission, contribution model, measurable outcomes; boards draft their own one-page charter with reserved human actions listed.
Board teams critique an agent-generated evidence summary, checking sources and biases before trusting it in governance decisions.
Review a Proposal & Grant Drafter output; practise amendment, debate, and the board's human-only final vote on enactment and treasury.
Translate Progress Tracker data into a quarterly board report with measurable outcomes and honest gaps.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised, aggregated governance self-assessment scores and charter outcome categories shared to a cross-nonprofit learning model; no donor, client or staff personal data.
programs.consent: Board members give written consent to contribute aggregated data; organisations may participate fully while opting out of sharing; any potentially identifying metrics are suppressed before aggregation.
